traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσονται κάμηλοι αὐτῶν εἰς προνομὴν καὶ πλῆθος κτηνῶν αὐτῶν εἰς ἀπώλειαν , καὶ λικμήσω αὐτοὺς παντὶ πνεύματι κεκραμένους πρὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν , ἐκ παντὸς πέραν αὐτῶν οἴσω τὴν τροπὴν αὐτῶν , εἶπεν Κύριος .

18.english_reference: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour [ cities ] thereof , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא יֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְ לֹֽא יָג֥וּר בָּ֖ הּ בֶּן אָדָֽם
traditions.VUL: non habitábit ibi vir , et non íncolet eam fílius hóminis .

traditions.KJV: at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea .

traditions.KJV: and spread his wings over Bozrah :

traditions.WLC: לְ דַמֶּ֗שֶׂק
traditions.VUL: Ad Damáscum .
traditions.KJV: Concerning Damascus .

traditions.KJV: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away :

traditions.KJV: Flee , get you far off , dwell deep , O ye inhabitants of Hazor ,

traditions.VUL: ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD ;

traditions.KJV: for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you ,

traditions.VUL: ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD ,

traditions.KJV: And their camels shall be a booty ,

traditions.VUL: ait Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD .
